}

}

        if S[n] == move_lower then
            lower_bound = lower_bound + 1
        elseif S[n] == move_upper then
            upper_bound = upper_bound - 1
        end
        if lower_bound > size then
            return NO
        end
        if upper_bound < 1 then
            return NO
        end
        if lower_bound > upper_bound then
            return NO
        end
        dbgpr(direc, n, S[n], T[n], lower_bound, upper_bound)
    end
    if lower_bound <= init_pos and init_pos <= upper_bound then
        return YES
    else
        return NO
    end
end

-- マス目からなくなるときにTrue
solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> String -> String -> Bool
solve h w sr sc s t = or
    [ solveL w sc s t
    , solveR w sc s t
    , solveU h sr s t
    , solveD h sr s t
    ]

solveL w sc s t = go sc s t
  where
    go !pos ('L':xs) (y:ys)
        | pos <= 1 = True
        | y == 'R' = go pos xs ys
        | otherwise = go (pos - 1) xs ys
    go pos (_:xs) (y:ys)
        | y == 'R', pos + 1 <= w= go (pos + 1) xs ys
        | otherwise = go pos xs ys

    go pos [] [] = pos == 0

solveR w sc s t = go sc s t
  where
    go !pos ('R':xs) (y:ys)
        | pos >= w = True
        | y == 'L' = go pos xs ys
        | otherwise = go (pos + 1) xs ys
    go pos (_:xs) (y:ys)
        | y == 'L', pos - 1 >= 1 = go (pos - 1) xs ys
        | otherwise = go pos xs ys
    go pos [] [] = pos > w

solveU h sr s t = go sr s t
  where
    go !pos ('U':xs) (y:ys)
        | pos <= 1 = True
        | y == 'D' = go pos xs ys
        | otherwise = go (pos - 1) xs ys
    go pos (_:xs) (y:ys)
        | y == 'D', pos + 1 <= h = go (pos + 1) xs ys
        | otherwise = go pos xs ys
    go pos [] [] = pos == 0

solveD h sr s t = go sr s t
  where
    go !pos ('D':xs) (y:ys)
        | pos >= h = True
        | y == 'U' = go pos xs ys
        | otherwise = go (pos + 1) xs ys
    go pos (_:xs) (y:ys)
        | y == 'U', pos - 1 >= 1 = go (pos - 1) xs ys
        | otherwise = go pos xs ys
    go pos [] [] = pos > h

                                               then Nothing
                                               else Just (a, b + 1, c, d)
          aa 'U' (h, w, sr, sc) (a, b, c, d) = if c + 1 > sc
                                               then Nothing
                                               else Just (a, b, c + 1, d)
          aa 'D' (h, w, sr, sc) (a, b, c, d) = if d + 1 > h - sc
                                               then Nothing
                                               else Just (a, b, c, d + 1)
          bb 'L' (h, w, sr, sc) (a, b, c, d) = if b - 1 < sr - w

                                               then Just (a, b, c, d)

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> String -> String -> Bool
solve h w sr sc s t = go0 1 h 1 w (reverse s) . tail $ reverse t
  where
    validate rMin rMax cMin cMax = rMin <= rMax && cMin <= cMax
    go0 !rMin !rMax !cMin !cMax (x:xs) ys
        | validate rMin rMax cMin cMax = case x of
            'L' -> go1 rMin rMax (cMin + 1) cMax xs ys
            'R' -> go1 rMin rMax cMin (cMax - 1) xs ys
            'U' -> go1 (rMin + 1) rMax cMin cMax xs ys
            'D' -> go1 rMin (rMax - 1) cMin cMax xs ys
        | otherwise = False
    go0 rMin rMax cMin cMax [] []
        = rMin <= sr && sr <= rMax && cMin <= sc && sc <= cMax
    go1 rMin rMax cMin cMax xs (y:ys)
        | validate rMin rMax cMin cMax = case y of
            'L' -> go0 rMin rMax cMin (min w $ cMax + 1) xs ys
            'R' -> go0 rMin rMax (max 1 $ cMin - 1) cMax xs ys
            'U' -> go0 rMin (min h $ rMax + 1) cMin cMax xs ys
            'D' -> go0 (max 1 $ rMin - 1) rMax cMin cMax xs ys
        | otherwise = False
    go1 rMin rMax cMin cMax [] []
        = rMin <= sr && sr <= rMax && cMin <= sc && sc <= cMax

  eval (Just (l,r,u,d))
    = l<=sc && sc<=r && u<=sr && sr<=d
  go [] [] = Just (1,w,1,h)
  go (s:ss) (t:tt) = go ss tt >>= g t >>= f s
  f 'L' (l,r,u,d)
    | l < r = Just (l+1,r,u,d)
    | l == r = Nothing
  f 'R' (l,r,u,d)
    | l < r = Just (l,r-1,u,d)
    | l == r = Nothing
  f 'U' (l,r,u,d)
    | u < d = Just (l,r,u+1,d)
    | u == d = Nothing
  f 'D' (l,r,u,d)
    | u < d = Just (l,r,u,d-1)
    | u == d = Nothing
  g 'L' (l,r,u,d) = Just (l,min w (r+1),u,d)
  g 'R' (l,r,u,d) = Just (max 1 (l-1),r,u,d)
  g 'U' (l,r,u,d) = Just (l,r,u,min h (d+1))
  g 'D' (l,r,u,d) = Just (l,r,max 1 (u-1),d)

#!/usr/bin/env ruby

DEBUG=false

UP=1
DOWN=2
LEFT=3
RIGHT=4

def safe_add(array, position, updown_flag)
  threshold = updown_flag ? H : W
  if 0 <= position and position < threshold
    array << position
  end
end

def first_move_only(array, i, direction)
  case direction
  when UP
    offset = 1
    updown_flag = true
  when DOWN
    offset = -1
    updown_flag = true
  when LEFT
    offset = 1
    updown_flag = false
  when RIGHT
    offset = -1
    updown_flag = false
  end

  array[i+1].each do |place|
    safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    safe_add(array[i], place + offset, updown_flag)
  end
end

def move_same_direction(array, i, direction)
  case direction
  when UP
    offset_check = -1
    offset_add   = 1
    updown_flag = true
  when DOWN
    offset_check = 1
    offset_add   = -1
    updown_flag = true
  when LEFT
    offset_check = -1
    offset_add   = 1
    updown_flag = false
  when RIGHT
    offset_check = 1
    offset_add   = -1
    updown_flag = false
  end
  threshold = updown_flag ? H : W

  array[i+1].each do |place|
    if place + offset_check < 0 or threshold <= place + offset_check
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
      safe_add(array[i], place + offset_add, updown_flag)
    elsif array[i+1].find(place + offset_check)
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    end
  end
end

def move_opposite_direction(array, i, direction)
  case direction
  when UP
    offset_same_direction    = -1
    offset_against_direction = 1
    updown_flag = true
  when DOWN
    offset_same_direction    = 1
    offset_against_direction = -1
    updown_flag = true
  when LEFT
    offset_same_direction    = -1
    offset_against_direction = 1
    updown_flag = false
  when RIGHT
    offset_same_direction    = 1
    offset_against_direction = -1
    updown_flag = false
  end
  threshold = updown_flag ? H : W

  array[i+1].each do |place|
    check_position1 = place + offset_against_direction
    check_position2 = place + offset_same_direction
    if check_position1 < 0 or threshold <= check_position1
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    elsif array[i+1].find(check_position1)
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    elsif check_position2 < 0 or threshold <= check_position2
      # nothing to do
    elsif array[i+1].find(check_position2)
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    end
  end
end

def copy_the_last(array, i)
  array[i] = array[i+1]
end

  end



  # i手開始前に後手(青木君)がいたら負ける位置(上下)
  places_ud = Array.new(N)
  # i手開始前に後手(青木君)がいたら負ける位置(左右)
  places_lr = Array.new(N)

  (N-1).downto(0).each do |i|
    p "S[#{i}] = #{S[i]}, T[#{i}] = #{T[i]}" if DEBUG
    places_ud[i] = []
    places_lr[i] = []
    case S[i]
    when UP
      places_ud[i] << 0
    when DOWN
      places_ud[i] << H-1
    when LEFT
      places_lr[i] << 0
    when RIGHT
      places_lr[i] << W-1
    end

    next if i == N-1

    # 前回(i+1)の負ける位置(対象位置)それぞれについて、
    # 対象位置とその上下左右(対象上下左右位置)を
    # 今回(i)の負ける位置として追加するかどうか
    case S[i]
    when UP
      case T[i]
      when UP
        move_same_direction(places_ud, i, S[i])
      when DOWN
        move_opposite_direction(places_ud, i, S[i])
      when LEFT
        first_move_only(places_ud, i, S[i])
      when RIGHT
        first_move_only(places_ud, i, S[i])
      end

      copy_the_last(places_lr, i)

      places_ud[i].uniq!
    when DOWN
      case T[i]
      when UP
        move_opposite_direction(places_ud, i, S[i])
      when DOWN
        move_same_direction(places_ud, i, S[i])
      when LEFT
        first_move_only(places_ud, i, S[i])
      when RIGHT
        first_move_only(places_ud, i, S[i])
      end

      copy_the_last(places_lr, i)

      places_ud[i].uniq!
    when LEFT
      case T[i]
      when UP
        # 対象位置 + 対象右位置を追加
        first_move_only(places_lr, i, S[i])
      when DOWN
        # 対象位置 + 対象右位置を追加
        first_move_only(places_lr, i, S[i])
      when LEFT
        # 対象左位置が負け位置でない場合
        #   -> なにもしない
        # 対象左位置が負け位置な場合
        #   -> 対象右位置を追加
        # 対象左位置が移動不可の場合
        #   -> 対象位置 + 対象右を追加
        move_same_direction(places_lr, i, S[i])
      when RIGHT
        # 対象左も右も負け位置でない
        #   -> なにもしない
        # 対象左 or 右が負け位置
        #   -> 対象位置を追加
        # 対象右が移動不可
        #   -> 対象位置を追加
        # 対象左が移動不可
        #   -> なにもしない
        move_opposite_direction(places_lr, i, S[i])
      end

      copy_the_last(places_ud, i)

      places_lr[i].uniq!
    when RIGHT
      case T[i]
      when UP
        first_move_only(places_lr, i, S[i])
      when DOWN
        first_move_only(places_lr, i, S[i])
      when LEFT
        move_opposite_direction(places_lr, i, S[i])
      when RIGHT
        move_same_direction(places_lr, i, S[i])
      end

      copy_the_last(places_ud, i)

      places_lr[i].uniq!
    end

    p "places_ud: #{places_ud}" if DEBUG
    p "places_lr: #{places_lr}" if DEBUG
  end

  else

  end

def overflow?(dp_i)
  [:U, :D, :L, :R].each do |sym|
    if dp_i[sym][:limit] - dp_i[sym][:S] + dp_i[sym][:T] < 0
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

  S = gets.chomp.split('')
  T = gets.chomp.split('')

  u_limit = sr - 1
  d_limit = H - sr
  l_limit = sc - 1
  r_limit = W - sc

  # dp[i][L or R or D or U]: i番目までSが上下左右に全ブリした場合の残りカウントとTが逆ぶりできる猶予個数
  # dp[i] = {
  #   L: [残りカウント, 猶予],
  #   ...
  #   }
  dp = []

  (0...N).each do |i|
    dp[i] = {
      U: {
        limit: u_limit,
        S: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:U][:S],
        T: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:U][:T]
      },
      D: {
        limit: d_limit,
        S: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:D][:S],
        T: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:D][:T]
      },
      L: {
        limit: l_limit,
        S: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:L][:S],
        T: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:L][:T]
      },
      R: {
        limit: r_limit,
        S: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:R][:S],
        T: i == 0 ? 0 : dp[i-1][:R][:T]
      }
    }

    case S[i]
    when 'U'
      dp[i][:U][:S] += 1
    when 'D'
      dp[i][:D][:S] += 1
    when 'L'
      dp[i][:L][:S] += 1
    when 'R'
      dp[i][:R][:S] += 1
    end

    if overflow?(dp[i])
      puts 'NO'
      exit
    end

    case T[i]
    when 'U'
      if u_limit - (dp[i][:D][:T]+1) - dp[i][:U][:S] >= 0
        dp[i][:D][:T] += 1
      end
    when 'D'
      if d_limit - (dp[i][:U][:T]+1) - dp[i][:D][:S] >= 0
        dp[i][:U][:T] += 1
      end
    when 'L'
      if l_limit - (dp[i][:R][:T]+1) - dp[i][:L][:S] >= 0
        dp[i][:R][:T] += 1
      end
    when 'R'
      if r_limit - (dp[i][:L][:T]+1) - dp[i][:R][:S] >= 0
        dp[i][:L][:T] += 1
      end
    end
  end

  puts 'YES'
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby

UP=1
DOWN=2
LEFT=3
RIGHT=4

def safe_add(array, position, updown_flag)
  threshold = updown_flag ? H : W
  if 0 <= position and position < threshold
    array << position
  end
end

def first_move_only(array, i, direction)
  case direction
  when UP
    offset = 1
    updown_flag = true
  when DOWN
    offset = -1
    updown_flag = true
  when LEFT
    offset = 1
    updown_flag = false
  when RIGHT
    offset = -1
    updown_flag = false
  end

  array[i+1].each do |place|
    safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    safe_add(array[i], place + offset, updown_flag)
  end
end

def move_same_direction(array, i, direction)
  case direction
  when UP
    offset_check = -1
    offset_add   = 1
    updown_flag = true
  when DOWN
    offset_check = 1
    offset_add   = -1
    updown_flag = true
  when LEFT
    offset_check = -1
    offset_add   = 1
    updown_flag = false
  when RIGHT
    offset_check = 1
    offset_add   = -1
    updown_flag = false
  end
  threshold = updown_flag ? H : W

  array[i+1].each do |place|
    if place + offset_check < 0 or threshold <= place + offset_check
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
      safe_add(array[i], place + offset_add, updown_flag)
    elsif array[i+1].find(place + offset_check)
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    end
  end
end

def move_opposite_direction(array, i, direction)
  case direction
  when UP
    offset_same_direction    = -1
    offset_against_direction = 1
    updown_flag = true
  when DOWN
    offset_same_direction    = 1
    offset_against_direction = -1
    updown_flag = true
  when LEFT
    offset_same_direction    = -1
    offset_against_direction = 1
    updown_flag = false
  when RIGHT
    offset_same_direction    = 1
    offset_against_direction = -1
    updown_flag = false
  end
  threshold = updown_flag ? H : W

  array[i+1].each do |place|
    check_position1 = place + offset_against_direction
    check_position2 = place + offset_same_direction
    if check_position1 < 0 or threshold <= check_position1
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    elsif array[i+1].find(check_position1)
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    elsif check_position2 < 0 or threshold <= check_position2
      # nothing to do
    elsif array[i+1].find(check_position2)
      safe_add(array[i], place, updown_flag)
    end
  end
end

def copy_the_last(array, i)
  array[i] = array[i+1]

      end

    when RIGHT

      end

      copy_the_last(places_ud, i)

      places_lr[i].uniq!
    end
  end

function loadGraph($N = false, $M = false, $both = true){
  if($N === false)$N = $GLOBALS['N'];
  if($M === false)$M = $GLOBALS['M'];
  $G = array_fill(1, $N, []);
  for($i = 0; $i < $M; $i++){

    if(count($values) == 2){
      list($a, $b) = $values;
      $G[$a][] = $b;
      if($both)$G[$b][] = $a;

      $G[$a][] = [$b, $d];
      if($both)$G[$b][] = [$a, $d];
    }
  }
  return $G;
}

function isOK($inc, $dec, $size, $current){
    global $S, $T;
    $max = $size;
    $min = 1;
    for($i = strlen($S)-1; $i>=0; $i--){
        if($T[$i] == $dec)$max = min($max+1, $size);
        if($T[$i] == $inc)$min = max($min-1, 1);
        if($S[$i] == $inc)$max = $max-1;
        if($S[$i] == $dec)$min = $min+1;
        if($max<$min)return false;
    }
    return $min <= $current && $current <= $max;
}

import strutils,sequtils,math,algorithm,future
template rep(a,b):seq = newSeqWith(b,a)
let yesno = (p: bool) => (if p: "YES" else: "NO")
type point = tuple[x,y:int]
proc `+`(a,b:point):point=(a.x+b.x,a.y+b.y)
proc `-`(a,b:point):point=(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)
type direction = enum L,R,U,D
converter toDir(c:char):direction =
  case c:
   of 'L':L
   of 'R':R
   of 'U':U
   else: D

proc solve(H,W,N,s_r,s_c:int; S,T:string) =
  const di: array[direction,point] =
    [(0,-1),(0,+1),(-1,0),(+1,0)]
  var lu = (x:1,y:1)
  var rd = (x:H,y:W)
  template fix =
    lu.x = max(1,lu.x)
    lu.y = max(1,lu.y)
    rd.x = min(H,rd.x)
    rd.y = min(W,rd.y)
    if lu.x > rd.x or lu.y > rd.y:
      echo false.yesno; return
  for i in countdown(N-1,0):
    case T[i].toDir:
      of R,D: lu = lu - di[T[i]]
      of L,U: rd = rd - di[T[i]]
    fix()
    case S[i].toDir:
      of R,D: rd = rd - di[S[i]]
      of L,U: lu = lu - di[S[i]]
    fix()
  echo yesno(s_r in lu.x..rd.x and s_c in lu.y..rd.y)

                 )
    elif body[i][1][0].len == 0: # variable: int | float | string
      vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
        body[i][0],
        newEmptyNode(),
        newNimNode(nnkCall)
          .add(ident("input"))
          .add(body[i][1][0])
          .add(newLit(1))
      )
    elif body[i][1][0][0].len > 0: # variable: tuple[field1, field2, ...: T]
      var tupleIdents = newNimNode(nnkIdentDefs)
      for ident in body[i][1][0][0]:
        tupleIdents.add(ident)
      let tuplety = newNimNode(nnkTupleTy).add(tupleIdents)

      vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
        body[i][0],

        newNimNode(nnkCall)
          .add(ident("input"))
          .add(body[i][1][0][0][^2])
          .add(newLit(body[i][1][0][0].len - 2))
      )
    elif body[i][1][0][0].len == 0: # seq
      if body[i][1][0].len == 2: # variable: seq[int | float | string | char]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
      elif body[i][1][0].len == 3 and body[i][1][0][2].len == 0: # variable: seq[N, int | float | string | char]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2])
            .add(newLit(1))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
      elif body[i][1][0][2].len == 2: # variable: seq[lineCount, seq[int | float | string | char]]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2][1])
            .add(newNimNode(nnkDotExpr)
              .add(body[i][1][0][1])
              .add(ident("Positive"))
            )
        )
      else: # variable: seq[lineCount, tuple[field1, field2, ...: T]]
        var tupleIdents = newNimNode(nnkIdentDefs)
        for ident in body[i][1][0][2][0]:
          tupleIdents.add(ident)
        let tuplety = newNimNode(nnkTupleTy).add(tupleIdents)

        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newNimNode(nnkBracketExpr).add(body[i][1][0][0]).add(tuplety),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2][0][^2])
            .add(newLit(body[i][1][0][2][0].len - 2))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
    else:
      discard

  for `var` in vars:
    letSection.add(`var`)

  result.add(letSection)

def aoki_win(n, chokudai, aoki, l, sp):
    """
    最後から範囲を削っていく
    """
    # print(l, sp)
    pp('AO', aoki)
    pp('CH',chokudai)

    chokudai_minus = 0
    chokudai_plus = 0
    for c in chokudai:
        if c == 1:
            chokudai_plus += 1
        elif c == -1:
            chokudai_minus += 1
    if 1 <= sp-chokudai_minus and sp+chokudai_plus <= l:
        # print('#1')
        return True
    chokudai_right = l if chokudai[0] == 1 else l+1
    chokudai_left = 1 if chokudai[0] == -1 else 0
    # aoki_right = chokudai_right -1
    # aoki_left = chokudai_right + 1

    for i in range(1, n):
        # print(chokudai_left,']','[', chokudai_right)
        if aoki[i] == 1:
            # aoki_left = max(aoki_left-1, 1)
            chokudai_left = max(0, chokudai_left-1)
        elif aoki[i] == -1:
            # aoki_right = min(aoki_right+1, l)
            chokudai_right = min(l+1, chokudai_right+1)
        if chokudai_left+1 >= chokudai_right:
            # print('#2')
            # print(chokudai_left,']','[', chokudai_right)
            return False
        if chokudai[i] == 1:
            chokudai_right = max(chokudai_right-1, 1)
        elif chokudai[i] == -1:
            chokudai_left = min(chokudai_left+1, l)
        if chokudai_left+1 >= chokudai_right:
            # print('#3')
            # print(chokudai_left,']','[', chokudai_right)
            return False
    
    if sp<=chokudai_left or chokudai_right<=sp:
        # print('#4')
        return False
    
    # print('#5')

    return True

def calc(length, start, target_chars):
    alive_section = [1, length]

    # [区間のどちらに作用するか, どのように作用するか]
    TX = {'L': [0, 1], 'R': [1, -1], 'U': [1, -1], 'D': [0, 1]}
    AX = {'L': [1, 1], 'R': [0, -1], 'U': [0, -1], 'D': [1, 1]}

    # 最後の青木くんのターンから
    for i in range(1, N):
        if AS[i] in target_chars:
            j, d = AX[AS[i]]
            alive_section = update(alive_section, length, j, d)

        if TS[i] in target_chars:
            j, d = TX[TS[i]]
            alive_section = update(alive_section, length, j, d)

        cross_check(alive_section)

    if not (alive_section[0] <= start <= alive_section[1]):
        print('NO')
        exit()


def update(alive_section, length, j, d):
    alive_section[j] += d
    alive_section[0] = max(0, alive_section[0])
    alive_section[1] = min(length, alive_section[1])
    return alive_section


def cross_check(alive_section):
    if alive_section[0] > alive_section[1]:
        print('NO')
        exit()

            left = max(1, left)
        elif t == "L":

            right = min(W, right)
        elif t == "U":
            up -= 1

            right = max(1, right)
        elif s == "L":

            left = min(H, left)
        elif s == "U":
            bottom -= 1
            bottom = max(1, bottom)
        elif s == "D":
            up += 1
            up = min(H, up)

        if left > right or up > bottom:
            print("NO")
            exit()

    print("YES" if left <= sc <= right and up <= sr <= bottom else "NO")

        for j in range(4) :
            sdp[j][i] += sdp[j][i - 1]
            tdp[j][i] += tdp[j][i - 1]

        tla, tlb = tdp[0][i], tdp[0][-1] - tdp[0][i]
        tra, trb = tdp[1][i], tdp[1][-1] - tdp[1][i]
        tua, tub = tdp[2][i], tdp[2][-1] - tdp[2][i]

def solve() :
    sdp = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(4)]
    tdp = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(4)]

    d = {'L': 0, 'R': 1, 'U': 2, 'D': 3}
    for i in range(1, N + 1) :
        for j in range(4) :
            sdp[j][i] += sdp[j][i - 1]
            tdp[j][i] += tdp[j][i - 1]
            
        sdp[d[S[i-1]]][i] += 1
        tdp[d[T[i-1]]][i] += 1
    
    for i in range(N) :
        l = sdp[0][-1] - sdp[0][i]
        r = sdp[1][-1] - sdp[1][i]
        u = sdp[2][-1] - sdp[2][i]
        d = sdp[3][-1] - sdp[3][i]
        
        tla, tlb = tdp[0][i], tdp[0][-1] - tdp[0][i]
        tra, trb = tdp[1][i], tdp[1][-1] - tdp[1][i]
        tua, tub = tdp[2][i], tdp[2][-1] - tdp[2][i]
        tda, tdb = tdp[3][i], tdp[3][-1] - tdp[3][i]
        
        if sc + r - (tla + tlb) > W or sc - (sc + r - tlb - W) - l + trb < 1 or sc - (sc + r - tlb - W) < 1 :

        if sc - l + (tra + trb) < 1 or sc + (-sc + l - trb + 1) + r - tlb > W or sc + (-sc + l - trb + 1) > W:

        if sr + u - (tda + tdb) > H or sr - (sr + u - tdb - H) - d + tub < 1 or sr - (sr + u - tdb - H) < 1:

            return 'NO'
            
    return 'YES'
